clue.text: Body Shop worker, a successful contestant on Eggheads?

definitions.meaning: someone who knocks dents out of car bodywork in a repair shop
Eggheads is a BBC quiz show where challengers try to beat a panel of quiz champions, so a winner beats the panel

explanation.surface: A shop assistant from the cosmetics chain The Body Shop turns up as a winning quiz contestant.
explanation.walkthrough: The capitalised Body Shop suggests the cosmetics retailer; it is a car body repair shop.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: a car-repair tradesman who hammers out dents, and literally one who beats the quiz panel.

clue.text: Indefinite number engaged in system of exercises standing on head in pain

indicators.note: engaged in means taking part within, so the number goes inside
in a down entry, standing on its head means turned upside down, so the letters read upward

parts.note: yoga is a system of postures and breathing exercises
N stands for an unspecified number in maths

explanation.surface: A yoga headstand with a vague number of repetitions proves painful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'standing on head' reverses YOGA to AGOY; 'engaged in' puts N inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Agony is extreme physical or mental suffering.

clue.text: Draw stumps or stump?

definitions.meaning: in cricket, pulling the stumps up marks the finish of the day's play
to stump is to baffle; in bridge an ... forces an opponent into a losing lead

explanation.definitionFit: Read as two words it means stop the game; as one, it is the bridge technique that leaves an opponent with no good move.

clue.text: Cookery expert twice reported nasty disease

indicators.note: twice means the sound appears two times in a row
reported means spoken aloud, so the written form differs

parts.note: Mary Berry is the British TV cookery writer and baking judge

explanation.surface: A cookery expert is twice said to have a serious illness.
explanation.walkthrough: Mary Berry is a well-known British baking presenter; her surname said twice gives the disease.
explanation.definitionFit: A disease caused by thiamine (vitamin B1) deficiency, affecting nerves and the heart.

clue.text: Bear market for gambling

definitions.meaning: the totalisator, a pool betting system at racecourses

explanation.surface: A stock-market slump suits the betting world.
explanation.definitionFit: To carry a heavy bag is to lug it, and the racecourse betting pool is known by this shortening of totalisator.

clue.text: Religious teaching given to English blues singer making rude jokes

parts.note: RI is religious instruction, a British school subject
Long John Baldry was an English blues singer of the 1960s

explanation.surface: An English blues musician takes a scripture class and ends up telling smutty jokes.
explanation.definitionFit: Coarse, vulgar humour or talk, especially about sex.

clue.text: Seagull — one following boat after equipment on it capsized

indicators.note: in a down entry, on means placed above the next piece
after puts the boat's trail at the end

parts.note: kit is equipment or gear

indicators.note: capsized means overturned, so the little word is flipped

parts.note: a wake is the trail of water that follows a boat

explanation.surface: A gull trails a boat after gear on board overturned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capsized' flips the little word it; in a down entry 'on' means stacked above, so the equipment sits on top, and 'after' sends the boat's trail to the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A kittiwake is a small ocean-going gull named for its call.

clue.text: Switching elements of wildlife programme is what keeps hunter going

indicators.note: switching the elements means swapping the two parts of the title around

parts.note: Springwatch is a BBC nature programme

explanation.surface: Changing parts of a nature documentary keeps a predator alive.
explanation.walkthrough: A hunter is a pocket watch with a metal lid over the face, not a predator.
explanation.definitionFit: The coiled mainspring drives the mechanism of a mechanical timepiece such as a hunter.

clue.text: The person setting familiar enterprise area in beach resort

parts.note: the setter refers to themself as I
biz is the informal word for business

explanation.surface: The crossword setter imagines setting up a business in a seaside holiday spot.
explanation.definitionFit: The Balearic island in Spain is famous for its beaches and clubbing holidays.

clue.text: Turner's skill with work of Art Deco (not English)

indicators.note: to work something is to shape it, so these letters are reshaped
not tells us to leave out the letter named in the brackets

explanation.surface: An art critic credits a skill of the painter Turner to his work in the Art Deco style.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turner' suggests the painter J M W Turner, but here it is a wood-turner. 'not' removes E from OFARTDECO, and 'work' rearranges the remaining OFARTDCO into OODCRAFT.
explanation.definitionFit: A wood-turner shapes timber on a lathe, a skill that is part of working with timber.

clue.text: Giving the Spanish wine that's sparkling and cold

parts.note: el is Spanish for the
Asti is a sparkling Italian wine
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: Someone hands over a sparkling Spanish wine served chilled.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that stretches under pressure is said to give, so a material with plenty of give is stretchy.

clue.text: Relating to parts of words just so, with blooming contrary content

indicators.note: content as a noun means what is held inside, so the reversed word sits within the other piece

parts.note: sic means thus, used to show something is quoted exactly as written

indicators.note: contrary means turned the other way, so this word runs backwards

parts.note: bally and blooming are both mild euphemisms for bloody

explanation.surface: A grammarian speaks of word parts while noting something is just so, with a contrary bloom inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blooming' is not flowering but the mild British oath; 'contrary' turns it round and 'content' places it within the Latin for thus.
explanation.definitionFit: Syllables are the units of sound a word divides into, so the adjective describes those units.

clue.text: Child's toy that can make star of Russian leader

definitions.meaning: a toy twirled on its point

definitions.text: that can make star of Russian leader
definitions.meaning: a tsar is a Russian ruler; spin its top two letters round and the result is a star

explanation.surface: A toy that might turn a Russian ruler into a celebrity.
explanation.definitionFit: The toy that whirls on its tip, and also a cryptic instruction: turn round the top of tsar to give star.

clue.text: Mark on list from radio play producer

indicators.note: radio is heard, not seen, so the words are spoken

parts.note: to check off is to tick an item on a list

explanation.surface: A tick on a list comes from a radio drama producer.
explanation.definitionFit: The Russian dramatist wrote plays such as The Seagull and The Cherry Orchard.

clue.text: Weed grassland yielding a great deal of hay!

definitions.note: a hay is an old country dance, so many hays are many such dances, a plural like the answer

parts.note: to hoe is to weed with a garden tool
downs are rolling open grassy hills, as in the South Downs

explanation.surface: A farmer weeds a meadow which then gives a huge crop of hay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hay' looks like dried grass, fitting the farm picture, but it is the country dance.
explanation.definitionFit: A hoedown is a lively American country dance, as is the old hay, so plenty of hays means several of them.

clue.text: Bond's declaration in game

definitions.meaning: James Bond might announce that he is a secret agent
the children's guessing game played by naming something seen beginning with a given letter

explanation.surface: James Bond makes a statement during a game.
explanation.definitionFit: A spy would say he is one, and the guessing game is named after the phrase that starts each round.

clue.text: Run in slot machine suitable for the Telegraph?

indicators.note: in places the run inside the machine

parts.note: a pin table is a pinball machine
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A run on a fruit machine seems fit to report in the newspaper.
explanation.definitionFit: Fit to be published in a newspaper like the Telegraph, which prints this puzzle.

clue.text: Martin singing about alien in danger of breakdown

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the singer's name goes around the alien

parts.note: Ricky Martin is the Puerto Rican pop singer
ET is the alien of the Spielberg film

explanation.surface: A pop singer sings about an alien and seems close to collapse.
explanation.definitionFit: Rickety describes something shaky and likely to collapse, like a wobbly old chair.

clue.text: Most piping plumber finally ends in raised support

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of the word
in places one piece inside the other
in a down entry, raised means read upwards

parts.note: a tee supports a golf ball
dies means ends or stops

explanation.surface: A plumber's work finishes in a raised pipe support.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ends' is a verb here, meaning stops; 'raised' turns the golf support upward in this down entry, and 'in' sets the verb inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A reedy voice is thin and high, like a piping voice, so this is the superlative.

clue.text: Urgent message set Republican in school

indicators.note: in places the set and Republican inside the school

parts.note: a school of players or a team works together
a leg is one game or set in a darts match

explanation.surface: An urgent note arrives telling of a Republican set at a school.
explanation.definitionFit: A wire message sent by telegraph, used for news that could not wait.

clue.text: Trotter, perhaps one supplied by meat counter

parts.note: Del Boy Trotter is the market trader in the British sitcom Only Fools and Horses
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A pig's trotter is supplied by a butcher's meat counter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trotter' suggests a pig's foot, which fits the meat counter; it is Del Trotter, the wheeler-dealer in the British TV sitcom Only Fools and Horses.
explanation.definitionFit: A delicatessen shop or counter sells cooked meats and cheeses.

clue.text: Agrees 13 of last month for Caesar

parts.note: December is the last month, abbreviated to Dec
in the Roman calendar the Ides fell on the 13th in most months

explanation.surface: Someone settles on a date of the 13th of December for Julius Caesar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of' and 'for Caesar' link: Caesar was murdered on the Ides of March, the Roman calendar's term for the 13th or 15th.
explanation.definitionFit: To settle on something or resolve it, as a jury reaches a verdict.

clue.text: Aim to enter merry union, making rude suggestion

indicators.note: to enter means to go inside, so the aim goes into the scrambled letters
merry suggests tipsy and jumbled, so these letters are mixed up

parts.note: an end is an aim or goal

explanation.surface: Someone sets out to join a happy marriage but makes a crude remark.
explanation.walkthrough: 'merry' scrambles the five letters of union, giving INNUO, and 'to enter' sends the aim into the middle of that.
explanation.definitionFit: An insinuation, often sexual, made indirectly rather than stated outright.

clue.text: Doctor coveting guerrilla

indicators.note: to doctor something is to tamper with it, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A physician envies a rebel fighter.
explanation.definitionFit: The communist guerrilla force fought in South Vietnam during the Vietnam War.

clue.text: Component of gunpowder in egg laid by sappers

parts.note: a nit is a louse egg
RE is the Royal Engineers, the British Army's sappers

explanation.surface: An explosive ingredient is planted in an egg by army engineers.
explanation.definitionFit: Potassium nitrate, or saltpetre, is one of the three ingredients of gunpowder.

clue.text: Sex appeal in stock attractive influence

indicators.note: in places the sex appeal inside the stock

parts.note: gravy is a meat stock or sauce
it is an old slang term for sex appeal

explanation.surface: Someone's allure is held to be a lasting feature of their appeal.
explanation.definitionFit: The physical force by which masses attract one another, drawing objects towards the earth.

clue.text: Ignore November in long period of time

indicators.note: ignore means leave out, so the letter is dropped

parts.note: to long for is to yearn
N is November in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone skips November during a long stretch of time.
explanation.definitionFit: Twelve months make up this length of time.

clue.text: Cor — with this you get explosive to hand over

indicators.note: says the answer, given Cor in place of part of it, becomes the explosive

parts.note: cordite is a smokeless explosive propellant
the clue word taken as it is

explanation.surface: An exclamation of surprise at what turns into an explosive handover.
explanation.walkthrough: A reverse-style clue: swap EXTRA in the answer for COR and you get CORDITE, so the answer is CORDITE with COR replaced by EXTRA.
explanation.definitionFit: To surrender a suspect to another country's legal system is to hand them over for trial.

clue.text: More than one rude peer searches the internet lacking energy

definitions.note: a plural noun: several lecherous looks

indicators.note: lacking means without, so the energy is removed

parts.note: to google is to search online
go is energy or vigour

explanation.surface: Rude members of the House of Lords browse the web without any vigour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'peer' looks like a lord, but here it is a look, and 'rude' means lewd.
explanation.definitionFit: Lecherous stares are leers, each an amorous look, so several make a plural.

clue.text: Expert in 10 around hospital ship

indicators.note: around means placed about, so the tree expert surrounds the hospital

parts.note: 10 is WOODCRAFT, so its expert is jokingly a master of trees

explanation.surface: A woodworking expert is found around a hospital, as if a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue refers to 10, WOODCRAFT: an expert there becomes a playful 'tree master', and 'around' puts H inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A sailing vessel with three masts, such as a barque or full-rigged ship.
